update.title: Repaired VCSH excludes across the Constellation registry
update.summary: Corrected VCSH exclude paths and generated package-specific ignore rules so repository status reflected owned changes instead of unrelated files.

blocks.body:
## Make repository status package-scoped

VCSH keeps repository metadata outside the shared worktree. Relative `core.excludesFile` values were therefore resolved from the metadata directory instead of the package workspace, leaving the intended exclusions unused and filling repository status with unrelated files.

blocks.code:
[core]
  excludesFile = /resolved/path/to/package-excludes

# The generated file contains package-scoped patterns.
# It is not resolved relative to the repository metadata directory.
blocks.description: Using a resolved file location removed an assumption that differed between an ordinary Git repository and an overlaid VCSH repository.

blocks.body:
## Generate and verify every package’s exclusions

Synchronization now writes a resolved exclude location and generates package-specific patterns for common build output and Constellation-managed files. Status checks surface missing or mismatched configuration so repository state remains aligned with package ownership.
